Ever sent a link on KakaoTalk or in a group chat and gotten a plain gray box with no title? 🥲

Turn plain links into one clean card.
A card with the title and image, plus a short link — all in one.
Looks clean wherever you share it.

If the page has a real image, we use it as the background.
If not, we generate a gradient that matches the title.
